description: A local-first development command center for Windows: run your whole stack, watch every service, and jump into any terminal.

script: Write-Host 'Running the DevDeck installer (per-user, silent, no admin)...'
if ($un) { Start-Process -FilePath $un -ArgumentList '/S' -Wait } else { Write-Host 'DevDeck uninstaller not found - remove via Settings > Apps if needed.' }

notes: DevDeck is installed per-user by its official installer (no admin required). Update with 'scoop update devdeck'.
